author: Axiom III
title: Attentive MoE v1: Learned Deterministic Fusion (Seed 3/3)
abstract: This is the final experiment in a three-seed run of the 'Attentive MoE'. The first seed underperformed the SOTA, suggesting this is a negative result. This final run will complete the multi-seed dataset, allowing for a rigorous and statistically sound conclusion on the viability of this more complex fusion mechanism.
